name: Whop Content Rewards clipping

product.purpose: Prepare 20–58 second campaign clips, publish them to the owner's linked YouTube Shorts channels, and submit each post to Whop Content Rewards.
product.safety: Dry-run by default. Live uploads require live=true and an explicitly approved campaign ID in the private CLIP_HOME config. Channel caps, spacing, segment overlap checks, pauses, and all side effects are recorded locally.

schedules.purpose: Scout approved Whop Content Rewards campaigns and process eligible clips.

your_steps.title: Connect the 10 YouTube channels
your_steps.detail: Follow step 1 in OWNER-STEPS.md to create the Google Cloud OAuth client and authorize each channel once. Keep client_secret.json under CLIP_HOME/tokens/.

your_steps.title: Sign in to Whop
your_steps.detail: Follow step 2 in OWNER-STEPS.md to sign in once and save the browser profile under CLIP_HOME/browser-profile/.

launch_gates: Dry-run remains enabled unless the owner sets live=true in the private CLIP_HOME config.
The owner explicitly approves campaign IDs before automated live posting and submission.
Whop and YouTube adapters must be present in the configured plugins before live mode.
A flagged Whop submission pauses that campaign on its channel; YouTube strike/terms errors pause that channel.
